12	def parse_evaluator_response(result: dict) -> dict:
13	    """Parse an evaluator agent's run result into action/reasoning/new_instruction."""
14	    if not result.get("ok"):
15	        return {"action": "abort", "reasoning": f"Evaluator agent failed: {result.get('reason', '')}", "new_instruction": ""}
16	
17	    # Try to extract JSON from the agent's output
18	    output = result.get("output", "") or result.get("reason", "")
19	    if isinstance(output, dict):
20	        return {
21	            "action": str(output.get("action", "abort")).strip().lower(),
22	            "reasoning": str(output.get("reasoning", "")),
23	            "new_instruction": str(output.get("new_instruction", "")),
24	        }
25	
26	    # Try JSON extraction from text
27	    data = safe_json_load(output) if isinstance(output, str) else {}
28	    if data and "action" in data:
29	        return {
30	            "action": str(data.get("action", "abort")).strip().lower(),
31	            "reasoning": str(data.get("reasoning", "")),
32	            "new_instruction": str(data.get("new_instruction", "")),
33	        }
34	
35	    return {"action": "abort", "reasoning": "Could not parse evaluator response", "new_instruction": ""}
